idea-plugin.name: Better Logcat
idea-plugin.description:
A modern Logcat tool window for Android Studio.
  • Multi-line messages and stack traces stay together as one entry, with expand and collapse.
  • Soft wrap toggle, resizable and hideable columns, compact or comfortable rows.
  • Tabs: one tab per device or package. Each tab keeps its own filters.
  • Opens on your project's app by default. Package picker with search.
  • Logcat-style search terms (package:mine, tag:, -tag:, level:, is:crash) with autocomplete, shown as chips.
  • Filter favorites and history with match counts; the last filter is restored.
  • Level toggles and a tag panel to show or hide tags. Package aliases for long names.
  • Double-click a message to select part of its text.
  • Time formats: time, date and time, full, epoch, or time since the previous row.
  • Block selection with Shift and Cmd/Ctrl click, drag selection and smart copy.
  • JSON detection with pretty view and pretty or minified copy.
  • Split panes, each closable with its own close button.
  • Screenshots and screen recordings (MP4 on devices, WebM on emulators).
  • Clickable stack trace frames, pause, clear and export.
Open it from the "Better Logcat" tool window. Assign a shortcut in Settings | Keymap | "Better Logcat".
